description: A Python module providing helper functions and classes for generating signed X.509v3 certificates using OpenSSL commands. It includes certificate creation, key management, configuration setup, and certificate chain writing.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents a public/private key pair stored on disk.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Helper class for building and managing an X.509 certificate, including configuration, key, and signing process.
